translator.evidence: Original AI-assisted om catalog covers all 1315 English source messages in 12 family slices. Technical identifiers, standard notation, and formatting were retained where appropriate; no upstream translated catalog is claimed. Updated 2026-09-28 with 69 original messages for change review, agent questions, permission rules, connectors, background runs, research progress and budgets. Placeholders and locale-specific plural forms are preserved; no upstream translated text was copied.

reviewer.evidence: AI-assisted independent semantic review read every message across all 12 slices. Corrected table-row terminology, untranslated selected-count and token-direction labels, and the artifact component label; checked key meaning, Oromo register, placeholders, plural structures, writing system, and English-identical entries. Source parser confirms complete ordered coverage. This review is not native-speaker certification. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
